title: ship-my-flutter configuration
$comment: This schema provides structure, defaults, and conservative editor checks. The CLI validator is authoritative for shell syntax, cross-field rules, and platform-independent path safety.

target_branch.description: Branch whose commits feed release pull requests.

release_branch_prefix.description: Prefix for generated platform release branches.

before_release_pr.description: POSIX shell command run after the next version and changelog are prepared.

before_candidate.description: POSIX shell command run before candidate source is fingerprinted and built.

enabled.description: Enable iOS release planning and delivery.

project_path.description: Flutter project root relative to the repository.

bundle_id.description: App Store bundle identifier. Explicit configuration is recommended.

scheme.description: Xcode scheme used for bundle identifier detection and exposed to the build command.

build_command.description: Optional POSIX shell build command. When omitted, ship-my-flutter uses fvm flutter build ipa --release if the project or repository has FVM configuration, and flutter build ipa --release otherwise. Chaining, pipelines, redirections, comments, and command substitution are rejected because ship-my-flutter appends version, build number, export-options, and configured flavor arguments to this invocation.

ipa_output_path.description: IPA file or directory relative to project_path. Override only when a custom build command writes outside Flutter's standard build/ios/ipa directory.

groups.description: Exact existing TestFlight group names that should receive the build.

wait_timeout_minutes.description: Maximum time to wait for Apple build processing.

mode.description: Whether promotion uploads only, submits for review with manual release, or submits for review with automatic release after approval.
